description_en: Restores the status of a site that has been disabled
description_zh: 针对已经停用的站点，进行站点状态恢复
name: RecoverSite

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

AccessType.description_en:
The access type. Valid values:

NS: access through NS hosting.

CNAME: access through CNAME
AccessType.description_zh:
接入类型。取值：

NS：通过NS托管接入。

CNAME：通过CNAME接入

CnameZone.description_en: The CNAME suffix of the site. For sites accessed through CNAME, this is the suffix that needs to be configured for the CNAME record
CnameZone.description_zh: 站点的CNAME后缀。通过CNAME方式接入的站点，记录所需要配置CNAME的后缀

Coverage.description_en:
The acceleration region of the site. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
Coverage.description_zh:
站点的加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）

NameServerList.description_en: The list of name servers assigned to the site, separated by commas (,). When the site is accessed through NS, this field contains values. You need to change the DNS servers of the site to these name servers. Then you can verify site ownership and activate the site
NameServerList.description_zh: 为站点分配的NS列表，用半角逗号（,）分隔。当站点的接入方式为NS接入时，该字段有值，需要将站点的DNS服务器修改成这些NS。随后即可验证站点的归属权，激活站点

OfflineReason.description_en:
The reason why the site was disabled. Valid values:

expiration_ arrears: the subscription plan expired or the account has an overdue payment.
internally_disabled: disabled by the system internally.
missing_icp: the domain name lacks an ICP filing.
content_violation: content violation.
proactively_disabled: you proactively disabled the site or the site was disabled due to the usage cap you configured
OfflineReason.description_zh:
站点停用原因。取值：

expiration_ arrears：订阅套餐到期或账号欠费。
internally_disabled：被系统内部停用。
missing_icp：域名缺少ICP。
content_violation：内容违规。
proactively_disabled：您主动停用或您设置的用量封顶停用

Status.description_en:
The site status. Valid values:

pending: the site is pending configuration.
active: the site is activated.
offline: the site is offline.
moved: the site has been superseded
Status.description_zh:
站点状态。取值：

pending：站点待配置。
active：站点已激活。
offline：站点已下线。
moved：站点已被顶替

VerifyCode.description_en: The site ownership verification code. When the site is accessed through CNAME, this is the TXT verification code that needs to be configured
VerifyCode.description_zh: 站点归属校验码。当站点通过CNAME接入时，需要配置的TXT校验码
